top.line: A plan for learning sites made from Wikipedia with DeepSeek: the next step for sovereign websites, into education.

in-short.line: Small tools, a site per topic, Wikipedia and DeepSeek, a review loop, age for legal, people from education.

idea.line: Good learning materials and visualisations from Wikipedia: the next step for sovereign websites, into education.

shape.line: A hub, tools that each do one thing, and a site per topic, each its own repository.

loop.line: Load pinned revisions, read with DeepSeek, check in code, make, review, approve.

team.line: Researcher, writer, second-model fact checker, age, safety, licence and accessibility reviewers, a conductor.

age.line: 16 and up or 18 and up is for the legal team; 16 and up assumed until then.

privacy.line: Static sites; models used only when making materials; nothing about readers sent anywhere.

collaborate.line: People from education shape topics, level and reviews, with their own repositories and AI.

steps.line: The hub and atoms with two tools, the review loop, the age decision, then more.

limits.line: A plan; age undecided; reviews reduce mistakes.

sources.line: My thinking on 21 November 2026, after the DeepSeek article.
